2018.description: The goal of this project is to make QtLocation interoperable with GeoJSON (https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7946). This translates into adding support for loading geometries from GeoJSON and exporting geometries to GeoJSON, as well as adding the required features to QtLocation to reach feature-parity with GeoJSON.
